items.title: AuthRedirectResponse
items.description:
Redirect response returned when an authentication provider requires the user
to continue authentication on another page.

items.title: AuthMfaRequiredResponse
items.description:
Response returned when authentication succeeds but must be completed with
a multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge before issuing a token.

items.title: AuthVerificationRequiredResponse
items.description:
Response returned when authentication succeeds but must be completed with
verification before issuing a token.

items.title: AuthRegisterResponse
items.description: Response returned from a registration attempt.

items.title: AuthLoginResponse
items.description: Response returned from an authentication attempt.

items.title: AuthCallbackResponse
items.description: Response returned from an authentication callback.

items.title: AuthMfaListResponse
items.description: Response containing the authenticated identity's MFA factors.

items.title: AuthMfaSetupResponse
items.description: Response returned when starting MFA setup.

items.title: AuthMfaFactorResponse
items.description: Response containing a single MFA factor.

items.title: AuthMfaRecoveryCodesResponse
items.description: Response containing newly generated MFA recovery codes.

items.title: AuthMfaStartPayload
items.description: Payload used to start MFA setup.

items.title: AuthMfaVerifyPayload
items.description: Payload used to verify a pending MFA setup.

items.title: AuthMfaDisablePayload
items.description: Payload used to disable an MFA factor.

items.title: AuthMfaGenerateRecoveryCodesPayload
items.description: Payload used to generate recovery codes.

items.title: AuthMfaVerifyChallengePayload
items.description: Payload used to verify an MFA challenge.

items.title: AuthVerificationRequestPayload
items.description: Payload used to request a verification token.

items.title: AuthVerificationConfirmPayload
items.description: Payload used to confirm a verification code.

items.title: AuthVerificationRequestResponse
items.description: Response returned after requesting a verification token.
